  CONCURRENT JOINT MEETINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  COMMERCE, JOINT POWERS FINANCING AUTHORITY AND THE GOVERNING BODY
  OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMERCE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  COMMISSION
The City will be conducting public meeting in –person in the Council Chambers and via
video/teleconferencing. To participate in the City of Commerce ‘public meetings and provide
public comments, please follow these steps:

1. Participate in person during the meeting, and submit public comments card if you would
like to speak on any item on the agenda or any other topic.

Watch or Listen: Meetings are broadcast/streamed live on the City of Commerce’s Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/City-of-Commerce-123903054365151/?ref.  Archived, on-demand
video of each meeting is maintained on the City’s Facebook as part of the public record.

2. Submit Comments before the Meeting: Members of the public can provide public comment
by sending an e-mail to cityclerk@ci.commerce.ca.us for City Council meetings, and the
comment will be read during Public Comment portion.

3. Live Remote Public Comments: Members of the public may submit live public comment via
Zoom conferencing by using the link below. You must download the Zoom app or software.
Zoom meetings can be accessed by telephone, computer, or smart device. You will be allowed
to speak during Public Comment portion of the agenda.

4.  At the time and date of the meeting, please click this URL to join the Zoom meeting:

https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84174538569?pwd=QUtoMDB6SDBZTlhONnJabjRNb1ZQZz09

Passcode: 114082 or join by phone: Dial 1(720) 707-2699; Meeting ID: 841 7453 8569

  Attachments:  Proclamation

3.  Library Update on Zip Book Grant Project
PUBLIC COMMENT
Citizens wishing to address the City Council and Successor Agency on any item on the agenda or on any matter
not on the agenda may do so at this time. State law (Government Code Section 54950 et seq.) prohibits the City
Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda .
Upon request, the City Council may, in their discretion, allow citizen participation on a specific item on the agenda
at the time the item is considered by the City Council. If you wish to address the City Council /Successor Agency
at this time, please complete a speaker's card and give it to the City Clerk prior to commencement of the City
Council meeting. Please limit your remarks to three (3) minutes.

To increase the effectiveness of the Public Comment Period, the following rules shall be followed: No person shall
make any remarks which result in disrupting, disturbing or otherwise impeding the meeting.

City of Commerce  Page 2  Printed on 10/20/2022
 City Council  Agenda  October 25, 2022

  CONSENT CALENDAR
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and may be enacted by one motion. There will be
no discussion of these items unless members of the Public or City Council request specific items to be removed
from the Consent Agenda for a separate discussion. lf the item is desired to be discussed separately, it should be
the first item under Scheduled Matters.

4.  Approval of Warrant Register Nos. 7A, 7B and 7C
  The City Council and Successor Agency will consider for approval the bills and
  claims set forth in Warrant Registers No. 7A dated October 25, 2022, No. 7B
  dated September 28, 2022 through October 10, 2022, and 7C dated October
  12, 2022 through October 19, 2022.
  Attachments:  7 A 2022
  7 B 2022
  7 C 2022

5.  Approval of Minutes
  The City Council and Successor Agency will consider for approval the minutes
  of the Regular City Council meeting of Tuesday, October 11, 2022, held at
  5:00 p.m., the minutes of the Special City Council meeting of October 17,
  2022, held at 5:00 p.m., the minutes of the Regular City Council meeting of
  Tuesday, September 27, 2022, held at 5:00 p.m. and the minutes of the
  Regular City Council meeting of Tuesday, September 13, 2022, held at 5:00
  p.m.
  Attachments:  2022-10-11 CC Minutes
  2022-10-17 CC Minutes
  2022-09-27 CC Minutes
  2022-09-13 CC Minutes

  SCHEDULED MATTERS

6.  Presentation/Update from the Sheriff's Department Regarding Public
  Safety in the City of Commerce

City of Commerce  Page 3  Printed on 10/20/2022
 City Council  Agenda  October 25, 2022

7.  The Second Amendment to the Contingent Agreement to Purchase and
  Sell Real Estate and Escrow Instructions to Wash-Tel Commerce, LLC
  and Citadel Holdings Group, LLC
  The City Council will consider for approval the revised Second Amendment to
  the Contingent Agreement to Purchase and Sell Real Estate and Escrow
  Instructions to Wash-Tel Commerce, LLC and Citadel Holdings Group, LLC,
  successor-in-interest to Craig Realty Group Citadel, LLC.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Resolution
  Agreement
  Second amendment - June 14, 2022

8.  Establishing New Guidelines and Authorizing an Increase in Funding for
  the Monthly Senior Rent Subsidy Program and Related Assistance
  Programs
  The City Council will consider for adoption a Resolution establishing new
  guidelines for the Senior Rent Subsidy Program and related assistance
  programs and updating program policies and procedures, and authorizing the
  funding increase that the new programs would require.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Resolution

9.  Citadel Black Friday Weekend Sales Event Planning Update and Funding
  Approval for Associated Traffic Control
  The City Council will receive and file an update on coordination efforts for the
  Citadel Black Friday Weekend Sales Event and consider adopting a
  Resolution approving funding for traffic control.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Black Friday Updated PP Pres - 2022
  Resolution

10.  Driveway Street Permit Parking
  The City Council will receive and file a report on a Driveway Permit Street
  Parking Program and provide staff with further direction if deemed necessary.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Driveway Permit Parking
  Driveway Parking Permit Program Policy

City of Commerce  Page 4  Printed on 10/20/2022
 City Council  Agenda  October 25, 2022

11.  Commerce Water Polo Teams Funding Request to Attend the “Team
  Vegas Founders Cup”
  The City Council will consider allocating funds from Community Benefits for
  five Commerce Boys & Girls Water Polo Teams to attend the "Team Vegas
  Founders Cup", in Henderson, Nevada on November 4-6, 2022.
  Attachments:  Staff Report

12.  Parks and Open Space Master Plan Update
  The City Council will receive and file an update regarding the Parks and Open
  Space Master Plan project.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Attachment

  ORDINANCES

13.  Second Reading and Adoption of an Ordinance Amending Commerce
  Municipal Code, Title 19 (Zoning), Chapter 19.11 (Manufacturing Zones)
  and Table 19.11.030(A) (Uses in Industrial Districts) to Add Additional
  Requirements for Funeral Services and Crematory Land Uses
  The City Council will consider for Second reading and adoption, by title only,
  and Ordinance amending Commerce Municipal Code, Title 19 (Zoning),
  Chapter 19.11 (Manufacturing Zones) and Table 19.11.030(A) (Uses in
  Industrial Districts) to add additional requirements for funeral services and
  crematory land uses.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Ordinance

14.  First Reading of an Uncodified Ordinance Approving a Development
  Agreement Related to Application No. 18-004
  The City Council will consider for Introduction and First Reading, by waiving
  the full reading and reading by title only, an Uncodified Ordinance approving
  the Development Agreement with M&M Commerce Holdings, Inc (a California
  Corporation) related to Application No. 18-004, for a commercial cannabis
  business at 4650 E. Washington Blvd., and making a determination regarding
  exemption from further CEQA review and direct staff to prepare and file
  corresponding Notices of Exemption.
  Attachments:  Staff Report
  Ordinance
  Development Agreement
  PC Resolution

CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY REPORTS

 City Council  Agenda  October 25, 2022

ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately
following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings)
in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California,
and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.
Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans
with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify
the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.
